Simulated monthly sea surface temperature time series

Source: R/data_sst_sim.R
sst_sim.Rd

A simulated monthly sea surface temperature (SST; degrees Celsius) time series based on the coastal waters off Jogashima, Miura City, Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan. The dataset is provided as a univariate ts object and is intended as an example dataset for state-space modeling of monthly environmental temperature time series.

Usage

sst_sim

Format

A univariate ts object with:

frequency

12 (monthly data)

start

January 1998

end

February 2023

Temp

Simulated monthly sea surface temperature

Source

Simulated data generated for tempssm based on Baba et al. (2024). The original study's supplementary code and test data are available at: https://github.com/logics-of-blue/sea-temperature-trend-jogashima

Details

The variable name is unified as Temp for consistency with other example datasets in the package. In this dataset, Temp represents simulated monthly sea surface temperature in degrees Celsius.

This dataset is not an original observed SST record. It was generated by simulation based on the state-space model analysis of sea temperature time series off Jogashima reported by Baba et al. (2024). The name sst_sim is used to make the simulated nature of the dataset explicit. Missing values, if any, are encoded as NA.

References

Baba, S., Ishii, H., and Yoshiyama, T. (2024). Estimating sea temperature trends using a linear Gaussian state-space model in Jogashima, Kanagawa, Japan (in Japanese with an English abstract).

Baba, S. (2024). Supplementary code and test data for estimating sea temperature trends using a linear Gaussian state-space model. https://github.com/logics-of-blue/sea-temperature-trend-jogashima

Examples

data(sst_sim)
plot(sst_sim)
